tasks.label: Compile and upload receiver
tasks.command: cd "/Users/scerruti/esp32 display/arduino-cam-lcd/receiver" && "/Applications/Arduino IDE.app/Contents/Resources/app/lib/backend/resources/arduino-cli" compile --fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32 receiver.ino && "/Applications/Arduino IDE.app/Contents/Resources/app/lib/backend/resources/arduino-cli" upload -p /dev/cu.usbserial-0001 --fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32 receiver.ino
